# 1, 0xb0 bytes). The walkers have no popcnt: a SWAR expression per u64.

# ddl's 0x258f110 (refused: over the transcriber budget): a 0x58 struct, a name string at 8
# (load_string 0x26f56e0), at 0x20 i32@0x40 structs of 0x38 (array reader 0x258f680), at 0x28
# i16@0x44 elements of 0x28 (array reader 0x258f2e0: a name at 0, at 8 i32@0x10 x 16 bytes, at 0x18
# i16@0x20 string slots read by 0x25e5900), then a linked list: any non-zero 0x30 is the next 0x58
# struct (advance 7, `jmp 0x258f122` back to the struct's own read).
### f258f110

IF|u64@0x8 != 0
IF|((u64@0x8 >> 61) & 1) != 0

ENDIF
ENDIF
IF|u64@0x20 != 0
IF|((u64@0x20 >> 61) & 1) != 0
ARRAY|i32@0x40|0x38|f258f680
ENDIF
ENDIF
IF|u64@0x28 != 0
IF|((u64@0x28 >> 61) & 1) != 0
ARRAY|i16@0x44|0x28|bo6sp_ddl_e28
ENDIF
ENDIF

### bo6sp_ddl_e28
